label: Expédition Dité
incarnation: Original personalised Dité survivor costume for MGS1 Solid Snake: weathered repaired grey-blue field jacket/cargo layers, black utility harness, small oxygen/filter canisters and compact folded respirator, worn repair-strapped boots; clear young human face, brown hair and navy bandana retained. An original fan game costume, not an attested released Solid Snake Survive incarnation.
